validation.notes: Repaired project-trust.ts, resource-loader.ts and settings-manager.ts. The regression links the real resolver, resource loader and SettingsManager through .prale-eval/subject.mjs and asserts: the resolver runs exactly once after a forced-untrusted bootstrap; the bootstrap package pass sees projectTrusted=false and global-only settings; session-only approval and denial work but write no consent; remember:true persists approval (true) and denial (false) exactly once; remember:false persists nothing; changing trust on a live loader reloads project settings in both directions; and setProjectTrusted alone clears/restores project settings without changing global storage. Mutation checks restored each source file alone to its HEAD baseline: all three produced a genuine node:assert/strict AssertionError (exit 1), never a crash, import error or timeout.
